verdict.rationale: Docs show self-serve on-demand GPU instances launchable via console or API in minutes, with preinstalled Lambda Stack, JupyterLab, and SSH access for immediate code execution; API supports cloud-init for launch-time configuration. Community evidence corroborates fast deploy and even third-party tooling built on the API confirming real-world usability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on timing benchmark validating 'minutes' claim end-to-end.
